name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump’s Fixation on Arctic Ships Led to Billions in No-Bid Contracts
changes.summary: The president decided to buy 11 polar icebreakers after a game of golf with Finland’s president. Experts say it’s far from clear the United States needs so many.

changes.title: Trump Administration Is Undoing Plans to Boost Workplace Heat Protections
changes.summary: The Biden administration took steps to shield workers from extreme temperatures. The Trump administration is taking a gentler approach with employers.

changes.title: Charges Dropped Against Ex-Olympian David Hearn Accused of Damaging Reflecting Pool
changes.summary: A former Olympian will not face trial after federal prosecutors acknowledged that the Trump administration’s claims of vandalism were false.

changes.title: How Ukraine Is Making Inroads With MAGA and a Trump Ally, Laura Loomer
changes.summary: Ukraine and its supporters have invested years in trying to undo the skepticism of the country’s war effort harbored by President Trump’s MAGA movement and the president himself.

changes.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
changes.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

changes.title: In Iran, the U.S. Appears Headed for a Strategic Defeat, Allies Fear
changes.summary: With none of President Trump’s aims accomplished and the Strait of Hormuz closed, U.S. allies see dysfunction and vulnerability from the war.

changes.title: Trump poses ultimatum on Blanche, will push for "anti-weaponization fund" if AG not confirmed
changes.summary: Todd Blanche previously repeatedly told Congress the "anti-weaponization fund" was "dead.".

changes.title: Week in Politics: Todd Blanche nomination; Michigan's Democratic Senate shakeup
changes.summary: Two nominations to watch: President Trump's of Todd Blanche to be U.S. Attorney General, and who Michigan Democrats will choose Tuesday to campaign for the U.S. Senate.

changes.title: The Democrats have one last chance to halt the erosion of US democracy – and it’s less than 100 days away | Timothy Garton Ash
changes.summary: American democrats need a Hungarian-style landslide to overwhelm Trump’s attempts to rig November’s midterm elections In these days of extreme weather events, it seems odd to say that the US needs a big landslide. changes.title: Cori Bush Has No Regrets
changes.summary: The internet had a field day last summer when a picture surfaced of Sen. Josh Hawley, R-Mo., with his arm around a former Democratic member of Congress. Hawley was at an event in St. Louis, Missouri, celebrating the inclusion of expanded funds for victims of nuclear radiation in President Donald Trump’s signature econo.
